ayahs.1: We sent Noah to his people, telling him: 'Warn your people before a painful punishment comes to them.'
ayahs.2: Noah proclaimed: 'O my people, I am truly sent to you with a clear warning:
ayahs.3: worship Allah alone, fear Him, and obey me.
ayahs.4: He will forgive your sins and delay your end until the appointed time. When the time set by Allah comes, it cannot be delayed—if only you knew.'
ayahs.5: He cried: 'My Lord, I have called my people day and night,
ayahs.6: but my calls only made them run farther away.
ayahs.7: Whenever I invite them to be forgiven by You, they plug their ears with their fingers, cover themselves with their clothes, persist in denial, and act very arrogantly.
ayahs.9: then preached to them publicly and privately,
ayahs.10: saying: Seek your Lord's forgiveness—He is truly Most Forgiving.
ayahs.11: He will send abundant rain upon you,
ayahs.12: supply you with wealth and children, and give you gardens and rivers.
ayahs.13: What is wrong with you that you are not in awe of the Majesty of Allah,
ayahs.14: when He created you in stages of development?
ayahs.15: Do you not see how Allah created seven heavens, one above another,
ayahs.16: placing the moon as reflected light within them and the sun as a radiant lamp?
ayahs.17: Allah alone caused you to grow from the earth like a plant.
ayahs.18: Then He will return you to it, and then bring you forth again.
ayahs.19: Allah alone spread out the earth for you
ayahs.20: to walk along its spacious pathways.'
ayahs.21: Noah cried: 'My Lord, they have persisted in disobeying me and followed instead those whose abundant wealth and children only increase them in loss,
ayahs.22: and who devised a tremendous plot,
ayahs.23: urging their followers: Do not abandon your idols—especially Wadd, Suwa, Yaghuth, Yauq, and Nasr.'
ayahs.24: Those leaders have already led many astray. So, O Lord, only allow the wrongdoers to stray farther away.'
ayahs.25: Because of their sins they were drowned, then admitted into the Fire. They found none to help them against Allah.
ayahs.26: Noah prayed: 'My Lord, do not leave a single one who rejects the truth on earth.
ayahs.27: For if You spare any of them, they will mislead Your servants and give birth only to wicked sinners, staunch those who reject the truth.
ayahs.28: My Lord, forgive me, my parents, and whoever enters my house in faith, and all believing men and women. And increase the wrongdoers only in destruction.'
